agent-orchestrator: Multi-step AI agent: Plan -> Act -> Reflect with human-in-the-loop approval, Redis session memory, and a replayable Postgres audit log. LangGraph + Claude. Runs without an API key.

zetsu-voice-agent: A voice-first assistant that runs entirely on your own machine. Wake word, barge-in with real echo cancellation, memory that survives restarts, twenty tools, and a neural voice — no API keys, nothing uploaded. ~500ms from you stopping to it speaking, on an 8GB M1.
pylearnweb: PyLearnWeb — learn Python the practical way. React + Vite landing page.
